blockers.title: First real off-machine backup destination
blockers.why: Needs the user to create/authorise a free account (Backblaze B2 without a card, or Google Drive) and run `rclone config`. Never done by an agent.

blockers.title: AI video generation (text/image-to-video clips)
blockers.why: No GPU on the build machine and no authorised free GPU account. compute.SimulatedRemoteGPU is a simulation, not a provider.

blockers.title: Platform upload via official APIs (YouTube first)
blockers.why: Needs the owner's own Google Cloud OAuth client + consent. Engine, approval gate, idempotency, resumable YouTube adapter and durable publish-upload job are built and tested on recorded responses (Account 3 stream E).

blockers.title: Analytics + monetisation intelligence from real platform data
blockers.why: No owner analytics in this environment. CSV import (YouTube Studio/TikTok/Instagram/Facebook) and YouTube Analytics API import are built; growth statistics ran only on a public CC BY 4.0 dataset.
